title: A Quiet Corner in the Library
topic: a school library creating a quiet corner for students who want to read during lunch
topicJa: 学校図書館が昼休みに読書したい生徒のため静かな一角を作ること
benefit: students can choose a calm place to read and return to class with better concentration
benefitJa: 生徒が落ち着いて読書でき、より集中した状態で授業に戻れること
challenge: the school must balance quiet use with the needs of students who visit the library for group work
challengeJa: 静かな利用とグループ活動で図書館を使う生徒の必要性を両立させる必要があります

title: Sharing Umbrellas at the Station
topic: a neighborhood placing shared umbrellas near a small railway station
topicJa: 地域が小さな駅の近くに共用傘を置くこと
benefit: people caught in sudden rain can borrow an umbrella instead of buying a new one
benefitJa: 急な雨にあった人が新しい傘を買わずに借りられること
challenge: umbrellas may not be returned and volunteers need a simple way to check their condition
challengeJa: 傘が返却されない場合があり、ボランティアが状態を確認する簡単な方法が必要です

title: A Morning Notice Board
topic: students using a classroom notice board to share important reminders each morning
topicJa: 生徒が毎朝、教室の掲示板で大切な連絡を共有すること
benefit: students can check deadlines and class plans without depending on one person to remember everything
benefitJa: 一人の記憶だけに頼らず、締切や授業予定を確認できること
challenge: old information must be removed quickly so that the board does not become confusing
challengeJa: 掲示板が分かりにくくならないよう古い情報をすぐに外す必要があります

title: Refilling Water Bottles
topic: a school installing a water refill station near the gym
topicJa: 学校が体育館の近くに給水設備を設置すること
benefit: students can refill reusable bottles and reduce the number of disposable drink containers
benefitJa: 生徒が再利用できるボトルに給水し、使い捨て容器を減らせること
challenge: the station needs regular cleaning and students must use it without blocking the hallway
challengeJa: 設備を定期的に清掃し、廊下をふさがないよう利用する必要があります
